content: SearXNG must add 'json' to search.formats in settings.yml or it returns 403 Forbidden to API callers (OWUI). secret_key must be set (SEARXNG_SECRET). limiter (SEARXNG_LIMITER) + bot detection returns 429 to automated callers; limiter needs Valkey/Redis; fix is pass_ip allowlist in limiter.toml/limiter.yaml for the internal OWUI container IP.
